title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Booking Cargo Type When a Disputed Demurrage Line Is Repriced
content:
## Clause

The cargo type on the booking plays a double part when the desk reprices challenged demurrage on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record.

- **It settles the rate class of reefer equipment.** The equipment class map supplies the class, with one qualification: reefer-mapped equipment is repriced at reefer-class rates solely where the booking carries reefer cargo, and at dry-class rates where the booking carries any different cargo type.
- **It switches the dangerous-goods uplift.** A dangerous-goods booking lifts every repriced demurrage day rate by the product's uplift percentage, applied to that same rate; no other cargo type lifts it.

## Effect on what can be credited

Uplift that the invoice charged on days or at rates the repricing no longer supports may form part of the credit; uplift that the recomputed amount still contains never does.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Equipment class in the map | Booking cargo type | Repriced class | Uplift on repriced rates |
|---|---|---|---|
| reefer | reefer | reefer | no |
| reefer | dangerous goods | dry | yes |
| reefer | another type | dry | no |
| dry | dangerous goods | dry | yes |
| special | another type | special | no |

**Q: A reefer unit under a dangerous-goods booking was invoiced at uplifted reefer rates. What does the repricing use?**
Dry-class demurrage rates, each raised by the product's uplift percentage, since the unit is a reefer under a booking whose cargo type is not reefer and the booking carries dangerous goods.
